test_title: PYST 17: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - GA (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Instructions: For each question, read the Assertion (A) and Reason (R) carefully. Choose the correct option:
Assertion (A): IMEC is expected to reduce logistics costs and transport time significantly across the India-Middle East-Europe trade corridor.
Reason (R): IMEC integrates railways, roadways, energy pipelines, and undersea cables to boost connectivity.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__

• **Assertion (A)** is correct because the **India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC)** is designed to create a more efficient trade route that is estimated to reduce transit time by approximately **40 percent** and significantly lower **logistics costs** compared to existing maritime routes like the **Suez Canal**.

• **Reason (R)** is correct as the project is a **multi-modal economic corridor**. It involves the integration of **railway lines**, **shipping routes**, and **road networks** to facilitate the seamless movement of goods. Furthermore, it includes infrastructure for **clean hydrogen pipelines**, **electricity grids**, and **high-speed digital cables**.

• The reason correctly explains the assertion because the **integration of diverse infrastructure** (rail, sea, and digital) is the specific mechanism that eliminates bottlenecks, streamlines customs, and provides a faster alternative to traditional shipping, thereby directly leading to the reduction in **transport time** and **costs**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The **IMEC** was officially announced on the sidelines of the **G20 Summit** in **New Delhi** in September **2023**.

• The corridor consists of two distinct parts: the **East Corridor**, connecting **India** to the **Arabian Gulf**, and the **Northern Corridor**, connecting the **Arabian Gulf** to **Europe**.

• The founding signatories include **India**, the **United States**, **Saudi Arabia**, the **United Arab Emirates (UAE)**, the **European Union**, **France**, **Germany**, and **Italy**.

• It is often viewed as a strategic alternative to China's **Belt and Road Initiative (BRI)**, focusing on **transparency**, **sustainability**, and **sovereignty**.

• Beyond trade, the corridor aims to enhance **energy security** and support the global transition to **clean energy** through the transport of **green hydrogen**.
